name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: A top bar with brand, links and an actions slot; links move into a drawer on small screens.
a11y: A header (banner landmark) with the links in their own navigation landmark named by linksLabel; the current page has aria-current="page".
Below 800px a Menu button opens the links in a drawer: focus is trapped, Escape closes it and focus returns to the button.
Put it first in the page, before main, so a skip link can jump past it.
